context: A retired exec mentors a boss
purpose: Teach: エリート/特権/指向/リターン/置き換え/手がけ/財務省/おおむね

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 特権意識を持つ組織は、いずれ倒れる。
lines.en: Organizations that grow comfortable with privilege eventually collapse.
lines.style: Measured, patient opening. A statement arrived at after decades. No rush in the cadence. Weight settles on each phrase. The voice of someone who has seen this pattern twice over.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おおむね、私もそう感じます。
lines.en: On that, mostly, I agree with you.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Respectful acknowledgment. Not deferential — meeting him as an equal, but with genuine consideration. Quiet sincerity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 財務省出身のエリート、指向は様々だ。
lines.en: Ministry-track elites — their directions are varied.
lines.style: Observational, almost detached. A factual note delivered without judgment. Slight rise of interest on 'varied,' as though this complexity pleases him. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 我が社、長期リターンを手がけてきました。
lines.en: Our company has made a practice of tending to long-term returns.
lines.style: Quiet pride without boasting. Steady, grounded. The voice of someone speaking about something built carefully over time. Measured conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 制度の置き換え、急ぐな。
lines.en: Don't hurry the replacement of systems.
lines.style: Final word carries weight. Brief, direct. No elaboration needed. A gentle warning from experience — the kind of advice that closes a conversation with respect. Slight fade on the trailing syllable.
